# Assignment

Create a self-contained R script or Rmarkdown file to do the following:

Import the bear data formatted for `secr` and fit the null model and a model where $g_0$ varies among the 8 occasions. Use `secr` to determine what an appropriate buffer should be.

Import the bear data formatted for `JAGS` (using the command `load("jags_bear_data.gzip")`) and tabulate the capture frequencies and the number of spatial recapture. Fit the model with occasion-specific $g_0$ in `JAGS`, and compare estimates and 95% CIs for $g_0$, $\sigma$, $E[N]$ and $N$ with the results from `secr`.

```{r setup}
library(secr)
library(jagsUI)

sch <- read.capthist(captfile="secr_bear_encounter_data_file.csv",
                     trapfile="secr_bear_trap_data_file.csv",
                     detector="proximity", fmt="trapID")
summary(sch)
plot(sch)
```
## `secr` Model fits

### Model $M_0$
```{r}
fm_M0 <- secr.fit(
  sch,
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~1, sigma=~1),
  details = list(fastproximity = FALSE), 
  buffer=150, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_M0)
predict(fm_M0)
```

### Model $M_t$

```{r}
fm_Mt <- secr.fit(
  sch, 
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~t, sigma=~1),
  buffer=150, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_Mt)
predict(fm_Mt)
```

### Determine proper buffer value

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# We can graph the predicted values and visually expect when buffer is large enough for estimates to level off

buffer_seq <- seq(150, 1550, by = 100)

est_buffer <- matrix(0, nrow = length(buffer_seq), ncol = 2)

for(i in 1:length(buffer_seq)) {
  est_buffer[i,1] <- buffer_seq[i]
  est_buffer[i,2] <- predict(update(fm_M0, buffer=buffer_seq[i]))[1,]$estimate
}

plot(
  x=est_buffer[,1],
  y=est_buffer[,2],
  xlab = "Buffer Value",
  ylab = "Estimate"
)
```


### Refit `secr` models

We see that it levels off around 800m, so we can refit our models with `buffer=800`.

```{r}
fm_M0_updated <- secr.fit(
  sch,
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~1, sigma=~1),
  details = list(fastproximity = FALSE), 
  buffer=800, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_M0)
predict(fm_M0)
```

```{r}
fm_Mt_updated <- secr.fit(
  sch, 
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~t, sigma=~1),
  buffer=800, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_Mt)
predict(fm_Mt)
```

## `JAGS` Models

```{r}
load("jags_bear_data.gzip")

# determine and tabulate the number of captures per bear
capture_freq <- apply(
  caps.2016,
  1, 
  sum
)
table(capture_freq)

# number of spatial recaptures
n_locations <- apply(
  caps.2016, 
  1, 
  function(bear) {
    sum(rowSums(bear) > 0)
  }
)
table(n_locations)
```

```{r}
model_string_Mt_faster <- "
model {
  # Time-varying baseline detection
  for(k in 1:K) {
    g0[k] ~ dunif(0, 1)
  }

  sigma ~ dunif(1, 2000)
  psi ~ dunif(0, 1)

  
  for(i in 1:M) {
    s[i,1] ~ dunif(xlim[1], xlim[2])
    s[i,2] ~ dunif(ylim[1], ylim[2])

    z[i] ~ dbern(psi)

    for(j in 1:J) {

      # Squared distance: no square root required
      d2[i,j] <-
        pow(s[i,1] - x[j,1], 2) +
        pow(s[i,2] - x[j,2], 2)

      # Calculate spatial component once per bear-trap pair
      kernel[i,j] <-
        exp(-d2[i,j] / (2 * pow(sigma, 2)))

      for(k in 1:K) {
        p[i,j,k] <- g0[k] * kernel[i,j]
      }
    }
  }


  # Likelihood for observed bears
  for(i in 1:n) {
    for(j in 1:J) {
      for(k in 1:K) {
        y[i,j,k] ~ dbern(p[i,j,k])
      }
    }
  }

  # Probability of no captures at each occasion
  for(i in (n+1):M) {
    for(k in 1:K) {
      prodTrap[i,1,k] <- 1 - p[i,1,k]

      for(j in 2:J) {
        prodTrap[i,j,k] <-
          prodTrap[i,j-1,k] * (1 - p[i,j,k])
      }

      PrNoCapOcc[i,k] <- prodTrap[i,J,k]
    }

    PrNoCap[i,1] <- PrNoCapOcc[i,1]

    for(k in 2:K) {
      PrNoCap[i,k] <-
        PrNoCap[i,k-1] * PrNoCapOcc[i,k]
    }

    PrAtLeastOneCap[i] <- 1 - PrNoCap[i,K]

    zero[i] ~ dbern(PrAtLeastOneCap[i] * z[i])
  }

  EN <- M * psi
  N <- sum(z)
}
"

M <- 200
J <- dim(caps.2016)[2]
K <- dim(caps.2016)[3]
n <- dim(caps.2016)[1]

xlim <- range(traps[, 1]) + c(-1000, 1000)
ylim <- range(traps[, 2]) + c(-1000, 1000)

jags_data_Mt_faster <- list(
  y = caps.2016,
  n = n,
  M = M,
  J = J,
  K = K,
  zero = rep(0, M),
  x = traps,
  xlim = xlim,
  ylim = ylim
)


jags_inits_Mt_faster <- function() {
  si <- cbind(
    runif(M, xlim[1], xlim[2]),
    runif(M, ylim[1], ylim[2])
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    detected_traps <- which(
      rowSums(caps.2016[i, , ] > 0) > 0
    )
    
    if (length(detected_traps) > 0) {
      si[i, ] <- colMeans(traps[detected_traps, , drop = FALSE])
    }
  }
  
  list(
    z = c(rep(NA, n), rep(0, M-n)),
    psi = runif(1, 0.5, 0.9),
    s = si,
    g0 = runif(K, 0.1, 0.9),
    sigma = runif(1, 100, 500)
  )
}

writeLines(
  model_string_Mt_faster,
  "SCR-Mt-faster.jag"
)

jags_pars_Mt_faster <- c(
  "g0", "sigma", "psi", "EN", "N"
)

jags_post_Mt_faster <- jags.basic(
  data = jags_data_Mt_faster,
  inits = jags_inits_Mt_faster,
  parameters.to.save = jags_pars_Mt_faster,
  model.file = "SCR-Mt-faster.jag",
  n.chains = 3,
  n.adapt = 100,
  n.burnin = 0,
  n.iter = 2000,
  parallel = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)


plot(jags_post_Mt_faster)
```

```{r}
jags_summary <- summary(jags_post_Mt_faster)

jags_estimates <- data.frame(
  parameter = c("sigma", "EN", "N"),
  mean = vector("numeric", length=3),
  upper = vector("numeric", length=3),
  lower = vector("numeric", length=3)
)

for(i in 1:nrow(jags_estimates)) {
  jags_estimates$mean[i] <- jags_summary$statistics[jags_estimates$parameter[i],"Mean"]
  jags_estimates$upper[i] <- jags_summary$quantiles[jags_estimates$parameter[i],"97.5%"]
  jags_estimates$lower[i] <- jags_summary$quantiles[jags_estimates$parameter[i],"2.5%"]
}
```
